<entry id="G00277">
<head-word>זִיד, </head-word>
<head-word>זוּד</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. דּוּד)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to flow over, boil</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sot. 11
<sup>a</sup>; Ex. R. s. 1, expl. זדו (Ex. XVIII, 1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition />
<notes>, v. 
<xref rid="B01359">בָּשַׁל</xref></notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֵזִיד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to boil, cook</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 69
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to יזיד Ex. XXI, 14) איש מֵזִיד וכ' a man (adult) cooks (prepares semen virile) and begets; Y. ib. VIII, beg. 26
<sup>a</sup> משיָזִיד from the time he prepares &c.; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to plan evil, to act with premeditation, in full consciousness of doing wrong</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 69
<sup>a</sup> ה' בזה ובזה זו מֵזִיד וכ' if he acted in full consciousness of both (of its being a Sabbath day and of such a labor being forbidden on the Sabbath), that is the wilful sinner meant in the Law (punishable). Ib. שגג … וה' במלאכה if he labored under a mistake as to the Sabbath day, but was aware of the sinful nature of the labor (if done on the Sabbath). Ex. R. s. 5, end; a. fr.—Part. מֵזִיד, f. מְזִידָה, v. supra. Y. Sot. V, beg. 20
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—במֵ' if done wilfully, opp. בשוגג. Ker. 18
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. מְזִידִין</plural-form>. Bets. 30
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. מוטב … ואל יהיו מ' it is better that they be ignorant than that they know and transgress wilfully; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="G00294">
<head-word>זִיהֲרָא, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<head-word>(זַהֲרָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key> Ar.)</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (זהר, cmp. זהה a. זהם) [
<italic>a glittering substance</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>gall</italic> (cmp. Syr. זהרא P. Sm. 1091, זהירא 
<italic>acerbus</italic>, ib.</definition>
<notes> 1090); trnsf. 
<italic>anger, injured pride</italic>. Gitt. 45
<sup>b</sup> אימליא ז' she was filled with gall (anger). Ber. 51
<sup>b</sup></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>venom, a fatal substance discharged by animals of prey on attacking</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. Zar. 30
<sup>b</sup> זִיהֲרֵיה חליש Ms. M. (ed. זיהרא קליש) its (the serpent’s) poison grows weaker with old age. Ḥull. 53
<sup>a</sup> שדי זיהריה it discharges its venom. Ib. 52
<sup>b</sup> ז' אית ליה … זיהריה it issues a fluid but its discharge does not burn. Nidd. 55
<sup>b</sup> נהי דז' וכ' Ar. 
<pgbrk id="pg392" />(ed. דזהי', corr. acc.) though the poison is removed from the body (through the secretion of the nose), the fluid itself (put in the eye) is not removed.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="G00299">
<head-word>זִיו</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.; = זהיו; זהה) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>splendor, glory, countenance</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sot. IX, 15 (49
<sup>a</sup>) ז' החכמה the glory of learning, ז' הכהונה of priesthood. Ber. 64
<sup>a</sup> ז' השכינה Divine Glory; a. fr.—ז' איקונין, v. אִיקֹונִין.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>good looks, bloom</italic> of health.</definition>
<notes> Koh. R. to III, 11 עדיין לא בא זִיוֹו וכ' my son’s former good look has not come back yet; Cant. R. to II, 5 עדיין לא בא בני בזִיווֹ הנשתנה וכ' my son has not yet recovered his bright looks which changed &c. Koh. R. l. c. זִיוָון של בני; Cant. R. l. c. זיותן וכ' (corr. acc.); Yalk. Ex. 272.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>bloom, forth-coming vegetation</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. R. Hash. I, 56
<sup>d</sup> bot. ‘the month of Ziv’ (I Kings VI, 1) שבו זִיוֹו של עולם because in it the world appears in bloom. Cant. R. to VI, 11 זיון של ירק (read זִיוֹו) the beauty of a vegetable garden.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<language-key>(b. h. </language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083">זִו)</xref></language-reference>
<italic>Ziv</italic>, name of the 
<italic>Spring-month</italic>.</definition>
<notes> R. Hash. 11
<sup>a</sup>, a. e., v. supra. Pesik. Baḥod., p. 106
<sup>b</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="G00452">
<head-word>זְכוּת</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (זָכָה) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>acquittal, favorable judgment, plea in defence</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—לִמֵּד ז' 
<italic>to plead in favor of the defendant</italic>. Snh. IV, 1 הכל מלמדין ז' all are permitted to plead for the defendant. Ib. פותחין לז' the opening argument must be for the defence. Ib. מטין על פי אחד לז' a majority of one is sufficient for acquittal; a. fr.—Ab. I, 6 הוי דן … לכף ז' judge every man with an inclination in his favor. Sabb. 32
<sup>a</sup> הבא ז' והפטר bring pleaders in thy favor (good deeds) and be acquitted; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>doing good, blessing</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Taan. 29
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. מגלגלין ז', v. גִּלְגֵּל.—Y. Naz. VII, 56
<sup>a</sup> bot. נתכוונתי לז' I had the intention of doing good; Treat. S’maḥ. IV, end. [Ib. תחלת זכותי, read: תשמישי.]</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>the protecting influence of good conduct, merit</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Peah I, 16
<sup>b</sup> top הז' יש לה קרן וכ' good deeds have a capital and interests (reward the author and protect his offspring).—R. Hash. 11
<sup>a</sup> בז' אבות for the sake of the Patriarchs; בז' אימהות for the sake of the Mothers (Sarah &c.). Ber. 27
<sup>b</sup> לית ליה ז' אבות has no distinguished ancestry to rely on. Gen. R. s. 44 זְכוּתְךָ עומדת וכ' thy guarding influence shall stand by them. Snh. 12
<sup>a</sup> בז' הרחמים ובזְכוּתָם through Divine mercy and their own merits; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>advantage, privilege, benefit</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 19
<sup>a</sup> ז' הוא לעבד וכ' liberty is a benefit to the slave. Tosef. Gitt. I, 5 היאך נמצא ז' וכ' ed. Zuck. (Var. מפני מה זכין) how dare we obtain a benefit for this slave?; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. זָכִיּוֹת</plural-form>. Yoma 86
<sup>b</sup> זדונות נעשו לו כז' wilful wrongs are accounted to him (who repents) as though they were merits. Taan. 20
<sup>b</sup> מנכין לו מזָכִיּוֹתָיו it is deducted from the rewards for his good deeds. Ex. R. s. 38, end; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>a</sup> ז' דידי ודידך my merit and thine. Keth. 10
<sup>b</sup> מאי ז' where is the benefit (that the word זכה can be used)?; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. זַכְוָון, זַכְוָותָא, זַכְוָ'</plural-form>. Targ. Deut. XXXIII, 21.—Sabb. 140
<sup>a</sup> מנכו לי מז' וכ' (Ms. O. מזַכְוָותָאַי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) it may be deducted from my reward in the world to come. Ḥag. 15
<sup>a</sup> למיכתב ז' וכ' to record the merits of Israel; למימחק ז' וכ' to wipe out the record of &c.; a. e.—Esp. (pl.) 
<italic>verdict in favor, title, claims</italic>. Keth. 85
<sup>a</sup> כתבו לי ז' וכ' give me in writing your decision in my favor, that they must pay &c. Ned. 27
<sup>a</sup> דאתפיס ז' וכ' whose papers were deposited in court; ליזלון הני זַכְוָותָאַי these my papers (claims) shall be void.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="G00455">
<head-word>זכי, </head-word>
<head-word>זָכָה</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. זָךְ)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to be pure, clear</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be acquitted, be right</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 107
<sup>b</sup> זוֹכֶה בדין he will be successful in his plea before court. Ber. 7
<sup>b</sup> זוכה בדין (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) he will be found righteous in Divine judgment; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be found worthy of, to be privileged, to succeed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. I, 5 ולא זָכִיתִי וכ' I did not succeed (in proving) that &c. Ib. 5
<sup>b</sup> לא … זוכה לשתי וכ' not every one is privileged to enjoy two tables (this world and the hereafter). Ḥag. 5
<sup>b</sup> תִּזְכּוּ להקביל וכ' you will be privileged to receive &c. Pes. 19
<sup>a</sup> זָכִינוּ שאין וכ' it was a good thing for us that &c. Erub. 54
<sup>a</sup> ז' תאוות וכ' if one is favored, ‘thou givest him the desire of his heart’ (without prayer), if less favored &c. Yeb. 63
<sup>a</sup>, v. נֶגֶד; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to take possession, have authority; to own</italic> (cmp. קָנָה); 
<italic>to gain, obtain a privilege</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. I, 3 אני זָכִיתִי בה I took possession of it for myself; ז' בה it is his. Ib. 4 זה שהחזיק בה ז' בה the one that took a hold of it, is the legitimate owner. Ib. זָכְתָה לי שדי my field (in which the object lies) has taken possession for me. Y. Kidd. I, 60
<sup>a</sup> top הראוי לִזְכּוֹת ע"י עצמו וכ' he who is legally qualified to acquire ownership through his own act, can obtain ownership through another person.—Erub. VII, 11 (81
<sup>b</sup>), a. fr. זָכִין לאדם שלא בפניו you may obtain a privilege in behalf of a person in his absence, but you cannot act in his behalf to his disadvantage; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (v. 
<italic>Pi</italic>.</definition>
<notes>) 
<italic>to benefit another person by one’s own merit, to transfer blessing</italic> &c. Eduy. II, 9 האב זוֹכֶה לבן וכ' a (good) father transmits to his son the benefits of beauty &c. Tosef. ib. I, 14 עד הפרק זוכה לו up to the age of majority the father’s merit stands by him, מכאן ואילך זוכה לעצמו after that he lives on his own merits.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to deserve well of, be of service to</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 34 (ref. to Ps. XLI, 2) הוי … היאך לִזְכּוֹת עמו reflect well how to be of real service to him. Ib. לזכות בו to deserve divine reward through him. Ib. שיהו זָכִין אלו לאלו that they may deserve well of each other (the poor being the instrumentality of bliss to the giver); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<pgbrk id="pg399" />
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>זִכָּה, זִיכָּ'</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to acquit, to argue </italic>or
<italic> vote for acquittal</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. 19
<sup>a</sup> יפה זִכִּיתָ וכ' thou wast right in acquitting, in condemning. Snh. III, 5 שנים מְזַכִּין if two vote for acquittal; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to obtain a privilege for, take possession in behalf of; to transfer, make an assignment to</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Kidd. l. c. זה זי' לבן דעת the one obtained a privilege for a rational being. B. Bath. VIII, 6 זי' בה לאחר if in his will (found on his body) he made an assignment to somebody else (as executor); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to transfer divine favor, to exercise a protecting influence on</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 111
<sup>a</sup> מְזַכֶּה את כל וכ' protects the entire town. Yoma 87
<sup>a</sup> לא דיין שזוכין לעצמן אלא שמְזַכִּין וכ' Ms. M. not only do they obtain divine grace for themselves, but they also transfer the same on their children &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to lead to righteousness, to convert, make better, purer</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib.; Ab. V, 18, a. e. כל המזכה את וכ' whoever causes a community to do good. Macc. III, 16 רצה הקב"ה לזַכּוֹת וכ', the Lord desired to make Israel pure; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִזְדַּכֶּה, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Nithpa</italic>.</definition>
<notes> נִזְדַּכֶּה </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be acquitted, to be found not guilty</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 30
<sup>a</sup> מדבריהם נז' פלוני the defendant has been acquitted by their (the court’s) verdict. Y. ib. V, 22
<sup>d</sup> top ובאיזו מִזְדַּכֶּה פוטרין אותו and on which-soever (of the two counts) he is found not guilty, he is acquitted; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to have favorable evidence</italic> or 
<italic>argument offered</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. 23
<sup>a</sup> נ' מפי עצמו if the defendant himself offers &c. Ib. הרי שנ' מפי עצמו (read מפי עדו).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="G00456">
<head-word>זְכֵי, </head-word>
<head-word>זְכָא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be clear, pure</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Job IX, 15. Ib. X, 15 זְכִיתִי (some ed. זִכִּי', corr. acc.); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to go unpunished</italic> (h. נקה).</definition>
<notes>). Targ. Jer. XXV, 29; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to deserve welt, do good, to obtain a claim on divine favor</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 34 [read:] אדם … זְכִי בי או דְכִי בי the beggar says … ‘obtain a claim &c. through me’, or ‘become pure through me’, (which means) זַכֵּי גרמך בי benefit thyself through me. Ib. אנן זַכְיִין בך we shall give thee something. Ib. ז' בהאי אתתא give this woman (me) something. Y. Ḥag. I, 76
<sup>c</sup> bot. שלח … מִזְכֵּי וכ' sent his son to Tiberias for his improvement (through study); Y. Pes. III, 30
<sup>b</sup> bot. יזכי (corr. acc.); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to become worthy of divine grace, to be privileged to enjoy, to live to see</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Job XX, 17; a. e.—Ber. 17
<sup>a</sup> נשים במאי זַכְיָין wherewith do women (who do not study the Law) deserve divine grace?—Sabb. 21
<sup>b</sup> אי זְכָאִי if I had been worthy (if the Lord had permitted me). Lev. R. s. 25 אי זָכִית אכלית if the Lord permit, I may eat thereof. Ib. אם זַכְיַת (תיכול) אכול if thou shalt live long enough to eat thereof. Ḥull. 50
<sup>a</sup>; Bets. 27
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. אִזְכֵּי ואסיק וכ' the Lord permitting I will go &c.; a. fr.—4) 
<italic>to take possession, acquire a title</italic>. B. Mets. 8
<sup>a</sup> מיגו דזָכֵי לנפשיה since he has a right to take possession for himself, v. מִיגּוֹ, s. v. גּוֹ.—B. Kam. 12
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>זַכֵּי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to clear</italic> (from rubbish).</definition>
<notes> M. Kat. 10
<sup>b</sup>; B. Bath. 54
<sup>a</sup>, v. זִיכֵּי.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to clear, acquit, justify; to leave unpunished</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Ex. XX, 7 (Y. מִזְכֵי, read: מְזַכֵּי). Targ. Cant. VII, 3; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cleanse</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. LXXIII, 13 זַכָּאִית Ms. (ed. זַכִּית, ed. Wil. זַכְוַת, corr. acc.); a. e.—Lev. R. s. 34, v. supra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to win, defeat</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. Zar. 10
<sup>b</sup>; Snh. 39
<sup>a</sup> כל דז' מלכא Ms. M. (ed. למלכא) whosoever defeats the king in argument. Ib. 107
<sup>a</sup> עבדא ז' למריה (old ed. כפייה) the servant conquered his master. Bekh. 8
<sup>b</sup> אי זַכִּיתוּ לי if you defeat me; ואי זַכִּינָא בכו (read לכו) and if we defeat you. Ḥull. 31
<sup>b</sup> זַכַּנְהוּ וכ' R. N. defeated the Rabbis; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to entitle, give possession to</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 78
<sup>a</sup> שטרא מְזַכֵּי לבי תרי a document giving a title to both contestants, i.e. one agreeing with two opposite opinions.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִזְדַּכֵּי, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִזְדְּכֵי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be cleared, to go unpunished; to clear one’s self, to defend one’s self</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Gen. XXIV, 8. Ib. XLIV, 16; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sense>
<definition> (זָכָה)

<entry id="G00467">

<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>

<xref rid="A00083"> ch. דְּכַר)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to mark</italic>,] 
<italic>to remember, mention; to celebrate</italic> (by a ceremony &c.).</definition>
<notes> Pes. 106
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Ex. XX, 8 זכור) זָכְרֵהוּ על היין Ms. M. (ed. זוֹכְרֵהוּ) remember the Sabbath (distinguish it) by a benediction over wine; Bets. 15
<sup>b</sup> זכרהו מֵאַחֵר שבא וכ' mark the Sabbath (by a ceremony) from another (Holy Day) which (preceding the Sabbath) may cause the neglect of it (Ms. M. לאחר, Rashi מֵאַחַר, v. אַחַר; v. R. Nissim a. l.). Men. 43
<sup>b</sup> ראה … וזְכוֹר וכ' see this ceremony and be reminded of another 
<pgbrk id="pg400" />&c.; a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. זָכוּר, f. זְכוּרָה a) 
<italic>reminded, remembering, mindful</italic>.—ז' אני, contr. זְכוּרַנִי 
<italic>I recollect</italic>. Sabb. 115
<sup>a</sup> ז' אני ב־ I recollect about &c.—Bets. 18
<sup>a</sup> ז' היא she will remember. Snh. 52
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—b) 
<italic>thought of, remembered</italic>. B. Mets. 11
<sup>a</sup> ז' ולבסוף שכוח if the sheaf had been thought of and was afterwards forgotten.—ז' לטוב (abbr. ז"ל) 
<italic>remembered for blessing</italic>. Gen. R. s. 16 end אליהו ז"ל El. of blessed memory, v. זִכָּרוֹן.—Sabb. 13
<sup>b</sup>, a. e., v. בְּרַם; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. זְכוּרִים</plural-form>. Pesik. R. s. 13, end; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִזְכָּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be reminded, to remember</italic> (with accus.).</definition>
<notes> Pes. 66
<sup>a</sup>; Snh. 82
<sup>a</sup> ראה מעשה ונ' הלכה he saw the practice and recalled the tradition. Yoma 38
<sup>a</sup> כביד אבותי נִזְכַּרְתִּי I was thinking of the vanished glory of my ancestors. Ex. R. s. 45 הִזָּכֵר remember; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִזְכִּיר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to be remembered, to recall</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 55
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. ג' דברים מַזְכִּירִים וכ' three occasions cause the sins of man to be remembered; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cite</italic> (as an argument), 
<italic>to take into account</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. 60
<sup>a</sup>; a. e. אין מזכירין מ"נ miracles must not be cited as evidence. Kidd. 40
<sup>b</sup> אין מזכירין לו שוב רשעו his wickedness is not counted; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to recite</italic> (in prayer), 
<italic>quote</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Hor. 14
<sup>a</sup> ושמותם אין אנו מז' whose names we do not quote (as authorities). Ber. I, 5 מזכירין י"מ וכ' we must recite the going out from Egypt (Num. XV, 37 to 41) in night prayers; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּזְכָּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be mentioned.</italic></definition>
<notes> Kel. XVII, 5. Toh. VI, 6; a. e.—
<italic>Part.</italic> מוּזְכָּר, f. מוּזְכֶּרֶת 
<italic>clearly defined</italic>. Kidd. 77
<sup>a</sup></notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="G00468">

<pos> m.</pos>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) [v.</definition>
<notes> זָכוּר,] </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>male</italic> (of man and animals), 
<italic>male child;</italic> opp. נקבה.</definition>
<notes> Nidd. III, 7 תשב לז' וכ' she shall observe the laws as after the birth of a male child &c. (Lev. XII, 4). Ib. בריית הז' the formation of the male embryo. Y. B. Bath. IX, 16
<sup>d</sup> bot. שמחת ז' the rejoicing over the birth of a boy; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. זְכָרִים</plural-form>. Nidd. 31
<sup>b</sup>. Zeb. V, 3, a. fr. זִכְרֵי כהונה the male members of the priestly tribe.—Gen. R. s. 13, a. e. המים העליונים ז' וכ' the waters from above are the males (fructifiers), &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="D00793">דְּכַר II</xref>) (של רחלים) ז' 
<italic>the male of the flock, ram</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Bekh. V, 3; Yeb. 121
<sup>b</sup>.—Shek. V, 3 ז' משמש עם וכ' that with the inscription ‘male’ was used only for libations connected with rams.—
<plural-form>Pl. as above. R. Hash. III, 4, sq. בשל ז'</plural-form> with horns of rams; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>membrum</italic> (of animals).</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Bekh. IV, 6, v. זוּבָּן.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (of inanimate objects) 
<italic>the thinner, pointed side of a double tool</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="G00471">זַכְרוּת</xref>.</definition>
<notes> Kel. XIII, 2 הז' the pointed side of the cosmetic tube, contrad. to כף the broad part.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>the marrow of horns, reeds</italic> &c. Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VII, 12.</definition>
<notes> [Ib. Par. II (I), 2, v. זַכְרוּת.]</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—6)</number>
<definition> (gramm.) לשון ז' 
<italic>masculine gender</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 2
<sup>b</sup> אשכחן דרך דאיקרי ל' ז' we find (in the Bible) 
<italic>derekh</italic> in the masculine gender. Mekh. B’shall., Shirah 1 בל' ז' in the masculine form (שִׁיר); Cant. R. to I, 5; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
